rows.grounds: compound of bāhya and ādāpūraṇa; accusative singular neuter
past participle of man, nominative singular masculine

items.question: Which breath-control stage is called pūraka when air is drawn from outside into the belly?
items.inference: pūraka is external inhalation into the belly.
items.plain_english: Drawing air from outside into the belly is considered pūraka.
